message.reasoning_content: I Have a Dream — MLK speech, August 1963. Songs released August 1963: "I'll Get You" (B-side of She Loves You, Aug 1963). Honey Pie Sep 1968; Don't Let Me Down Feb 1969; I'll Be on My Way — recorded 1963, released 1979... but released on the UK EP? Actually "I'll Be on My Way" was a BBC recording released 1994. Go with I'll Get You.
